stages.description: Make adjust_stock atomic and guarded: replace the read-then-write pair with a single UPDATE inventory SET stock_qty = stock_qty + ? WHERE product_id = ? AND stock_qty + ? >= 0, checking rowcount to detect both 'unknown product' and 'would go negative'. This is the interface stage 2 will have cart call instead of duplicating.
acceptance_criteria: test_get_stock, test_adjust_stock_increases, test_adjust_stock_decreases, test_adjust_stock_unknown_product all still pass.

test_adjust_stock_allows_negative_result's expectation flips from 'accepts and returns -5' to 'rejected with 400 and stock unchanged at 5' - update that test as part of this stage and confirm it passes with the new behavior, not just that old tests still pass.
The UPDATE statement is the only place stock_qty is written in this file - no separate SELECT-then-UPDATE remains.

stages.description: Replace checkout's duplicated read-modify-write stock decrement with a call to inventory's now-atomic, now-guarded decrement from stage 1, instead of reimplementing it. This is the fix for the cart/inventory duplication finding from Phase 1/2.
acceptance_criteria: New test: checking out more units than are in stock is now rejected (400, no order created, no partial decrement) - this is a deliberate behavior change, a direct consequence of routing through stage 1's guarded decrement, and needs its own explicit test rather than being folded silently into 'existing tests pass.'
cart/routes.py no longer contains its own SELECT/UPDATE against the inventory table - it calls into inventory's interface instead.

stages.description: Add idempotency protection to checkout: require an idempotency_key field in the request body, store it against the created order, and return the original order (no new order, no new decrement) if the same key is submitted again.
acceptance_criteria: test_checkout_has_no_idempotency_protection's expectation flips: submitting the same idempotency_key twice returns the same order_id both times and stock is decremented only once - update and rename that test as part of this stage.
A request without an idempotency_key is rejected with 400 rather than silently proceeding unprotected.
All other existing cart tests still pass with an idempotency_key added to their request payloads.

stages.description: Replace list_products' N+1 query pattern (one query per product for stock) with a single query joining products and inventory.
acceptance_criteria: test_list_products_includes_stock and test_create_product_seeds_inventory still pass, same response shape.
grep confirms list_products contains exactly one db.execute call, not one plus a per-row loop.
